A command line interface for interacting with the Camber platform.
Documentation: https://docs.cambercloud.com

Usage:
  camber [command]

Available Commands:
  agent       Camber agent manager
  app         Camber application manager
  chat        Chat with a Camber AI agent
  engine      Camber engine manager
  help        Help about any command
  job         Camber job manager
  login       Login to Camber platform via WebUI
  me          Get user profile information
  pod         Manage agent pod worker runs
  stash       List, Remove, Copy files in Stash
  tag         Camber tag manager
  team        Manage teams
  update      Update Camber CLI to latest version
  version     Display the version of Camber CLI

Flags:
      --api-key string   API key for authentication (also set via CAMBER_API_KEY env var)
  -h, --help             help for camber

Use "camber [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Create, fetch status, and fetch logs for jobs.

Usage:
  camber job [command]

Available Commands:
  create      Create job resources.
  get         Get job status.
  list        List jobs.
  logs        View job logs

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for job

Global Flags:
      --api-key string   API key for authentication (also set via CAMBER_API_KEY env var)

Use "camber job [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Create job resources.

Usage:
  camber job create [flags]

Flags:
      --cmd string      command for the job (required)
      --engine string   Type for the job (required): base, mpi, mesa, athena, nextflow, gromacs, lammps, openfoam (default "base")
      --gpu             Whether to use GPU (default: false)
  -h, --help            help for create
      --num-nodes int   Number of nodes to use (default: 1) (default 1)
      --path string     Input stash path for the job (e.g., stash://project/) (required)
      --size string     Node size for the job (required): xxsmall, xsmall, small, medium, large (default "xxsmall")

Global Flags:
      --api-key string   API key for authentication (also set via CAMBER_API_KEY env var)

base                Base computing environment, include sklearn, pytorch, pandas, matplotlib, pytorch, MPI and more
mpi                 Message passing interface, popular framework for distributed physics simulations, using OpenMPI.
mesa                Popular 1-D astrophysical stellar structure code.
athena              Runs AthenaK, the GPU-enabled astrophysical radiation magnetohydrodynamics code.
nextflow            Runs containerized workflow flows for genomics data analysis.
gromacs             Widely used molecular dynamics simulation package, especially relevant for biological setting.
lammps              Molecular dynamical simulator for condensed matter physics.
openfoam            General purpose open-source computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation package.
